description: Typed FACTUAL edge between two open-government records, or between a gov.dataset record and a corp identity-registry entity, computed by danjo_crossref_engine. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605301600 §3. Each link cites the public basis of the assertion; it is the substrate from which danjo.discrepancyObservation records are derived. NON-adjudicating: a link asserts a factual relationship (e.g. 'awardeeLei X is a control-edge of officialEntity Y per GLEIF L2 / OpenCorporates'), never wrongdoing.

fromRef.description: Source side: a gov.dataset.* record CID/at-uri OR a corp registry entity id (LEI)

toRef.description: Target side: a gov.dataset.* record CID/at-uri OR a corp registry entity id (LEI)

basisRecordCids.description: Public-record CIDs that justify the edge (gov.dataset.* and/or corp.{leiReference,ownershipEdge})

confidence.description: Match basis. `name-normalized-candidate` (fuzzy) MUST NOT alone ground an `elevated`-severity observation.
